title: Source: Anthropic plans a safety system this year requiring enterprises to retain data for 30 days, with an option to do so on their own cloud infrastructure (Rachel Metz/Bloomberg)
summary: Rachel Metz / Bloomberg: Source: Anthropic plans a safety system this year requiring enterprises to retain data for 30 days, with an option to do so on their own cloud infrastructure — Anthropic PBC plans to allow business customers to keep greater control of their data when using its most capable artificial intelligence models …
